items.title: John Bunch interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: Well not Sonny — the Sonny Rollins that I used to know.

ctx.x: What’s your favorite setting? Your overall favorite setting as a keyboard artist?

My favorite setting would be just playing the piano in about a quartet with a good horn player. Maybe one or maybe two. With Sonny Rollins or somebody like that. Well not Sonny — the Sonny Rollins that I used to know. I hope he doesn’t hear that. Are you going to interview him?
